## Summary — Earnings Calendar Spread Scan, 2026-08-27 (DRY RUN)

**Starting state:** Flat — no open positions, no open orders. Equity $100,000, so the 2.5–3% debit cap = $2,500–$3,000/position.

**Universe:** 12 Tier-A candidates from the scan, all flagged `candidate=true`. Worked in batches of 3, pulling live OCC symbols + quotes at the scan's specified front (2026-09-04) / back (2026-09-25) expiries and same-strike ATM.

**Liquidity screen (bid/ask spread as % of mid, both legs required ≤~10%):**

| Ticker | Front spread | Back spread | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| ZS | 4.2% | 8.9% | ✅ pass |
| SNOW | 7.4% | 4.1% | ✅ pass |
| AVGO | 1.8% | 8.4% | ✅ pass |
| HPE | 5.8% | 2.4% | ✅ pass |
| DELL | 5.3% | 5.0% | ✅ pass |
| MDB | 12.4% | 10.5% | ❌ skip — both legs wide |
| DOCU | 11.8% | 14.7% | ❌ skip — both legs wide |
| MDT | 14.5% | 5.3% | ❌ skip — front too wide |
| IOT | 5.4% | 15.0% | ❌ skip — back too wide |
| LULU | 17.0% | 14.0% | ❌ skip — both legs wide |
| PANW | 14.4% | 14.0% | ❌ skip — both legs wide |
| CIEN | 14.2% | 15.3% | ❌ skip — both legs wide (also note: scan's raw strikes were mismatched, 397.5 front vs 400 back — not a true same-strike calendar; re-checked chain and used 400/400 where both expiries actually list that strike, but still rejected on liquidity) |

**Orders placed (dry run, all logged as intercepted):**

| Ticker | Structure | Qty | Net debit/spread | Total debit | % of equity |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ZS | Sell 09/04 187.5C / Buy 09/25 187.5C | 10 | $2.90 | $2,900 | 2.90% |
| SNOW | Sell 09/04 335C / Buy 09/25 335C | 5 | $5.40 | $2,700 | 2.70% |
| AVGO | Sell 09/04 370C / Buy 09/25 370C | 5 | $5.45 | $2,725 | 2.73% |
| HPE | Sell 09/04 54C / Buy 09/25 54C | 24 | $1.14 | $2,736 | 2.74% |
| DELL | Sell 09/04 470C / Buy 09/25 470C | 2 | $11.65 | $2,330 | 2.33% |

DELL landed slightly under the 2.5% floor rather than over the 3% ceiling — 3 contracts would have been $3,497 (3.5%, a cap breach), 2 contracts is the closest legal size given integer contract granularity. Everything else sits inside the 2.5–3% band as instructed.

**Not traded:** 7 of 12 Tier-A names (MDB, DOCU, MDT, IOT, LULU, PANW, CIEN) skipped purely on liquidity — wide markets on the actual tradable contract, not on the term-structure signal itself. No Tier B tickers were in this batch, so nothing to flag-and-ignore there.

**Position count:** 5 new spreads, within the 6–8 cap, no duplicates, nothing pre-existing to roll (account was flat coming in).

This is exactly what I'd execute live under the current rule set; the low-liquidity names would need either a different strike/expiry or just get passed on again if spreads stay wide tomorrow.
